::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal" icon="false" title="Purpose"}
Check that your team's clean dataset supports your project and begin using it.
Submit a brief progress reflection so the instructor can see what is working
and help resolve specific data needs.
:::

The instructor is handling the bulk of the data cleaning. Your team's role at
this checkpoint is to verify that the prepared data fits your questions, try an
analysis, and identify any changes or additional data you need.

[Project Prompt](project_1_prompt.qmd) | [Analysis Plan](project_1_analysis_plan.qmd) | [Timeline by Section](project_1_timeline.qmd)

## 1) Download and Check Your Clean Data

Open your group's Posit Cloud project and locate the current clean `.csv` file,
usually in `team/`. Read `data/DATA_NOTES.md` and any instructor notes about the
prepared data. If the file is missing or you are unsure which version to use,
ask the instructor and identify that blocker in your reflection.

In the **Files** pane, check the box beside the clean CSV. Open **More** (the
gear or more options menu), choose **Export**, and download the file. All
teammates should use the same version.

Compare the data with your current `team/analysis_plan.qmd`:

- Do the observations, time period, and population fit your project questions?
- Are the variables, groups, units, and measures you need available?
- Do missing values, sample sizes, or other limitations affect a planned analysis?

Update the working Analysis Plan if your questions or data needs have changed.

## 2) Start an Analysis

Use the downloaded data to begin **one** relevant analysis in **Excel or
Tableau**, or attempt a **hypothesis test in R** using the clean data in your
group project. Choose work that moves one of your team's questions forward.
For example, create a grouped summary table, make a chart comparing groups, or
try a chi-square test for two categorical variables.

Save your work so you can continue it. In your reflection, name the variables
and tool you used, describe what you tried, and report an initial finding or
what prevented the analysis from working. An attempted analysis with a specific
blocker is useful evidence of progress. If the clean file is unavailable,
identify the analysis you are ready to attempt and the file or data you need.

## 3) Submit a Quick Team Reflection

One teammate submits for the team in **Prep Work: Clean Data Set** in Canvas.
Use the text entry box or upload a short PDF. Include your group number,
teammate names, Posit Cloud project link, and exact clean CSV filename.

Use these four bullets; a few sentences for each is enough:

1. **Data access:** Which clean file did you download and open? If you could not
   access it, explain what happened.
2. **Fit for your needs:** Which project question can you address with these
   data? Identify the variables you checked and any important limitation.
3. **Analysis progress:** What did you try in Excel, Tableau, or R? Name the
   variables and describe an initial result or specific obstacle. Identify the
   saved work file or its location. A screenshot or small output excerpt is
   optional.
4. **Requests and next step:** Specify any changes or new data you need and
   explain which question they would support. Name the needed variable or
   measure, time period, population, source, or matching key when relevant.
   If no changes are needed, say so. State your team's next analysis step and
   who will take it.

For example, a useful request explains that you need monthly counts by ZIP code
for a particular period to calculate a rate. "We need more data" does not give
the instructor enough information to act.

**Do not upload the clean CSV.** Keep it and your saved analysis work in the
group project or shared team workspace. This checkpoint requires the short
reflection; a preparation PDF or completed hypothesis document is not required.
Keep the preparation source in your project for the final technical documentation.

## Checklist

- [ ] We identified the current clean file and verified access, or described a blocker.
- [ ] We checked whether the data supports a project question.
- [ ] We described an analysis attempt or the specific data needed to begin.
- [ ] We listed actionable requests and our next step.
- [ ] Our reflection identifies the team, project, clean file, and saved analysis work.

## Grading Basis

This is a **pass/fail team progress checkpoint** under the existing
[prep-work policy](project_1_prompt.qmd#prep-work). Credit is based on a specific,
complete account of your data check, analysis progress or blocker, and next step.
A successful test or finished analysis is not required. Use the due date shown
in Canvas and on your section's timeline.
